blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: nested SELECT — Query inside another query.
IN — Compare value against returned set.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: SELECT names output columns, FROM identifies input tables and WHERE restricts rows using a Boolean predicate.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: INNER JOIN combines rows matching a join condition. A nested SELECT can return a set of keys used by an outer IN condition.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Both example queries return Ada and Ben, but joining is more flexible when fields from both tables are required.

Choose the response that best addresses this independent task: QUESTION 1 OF 3 Write SELECT to show all Name values in Student sorted by Name ascending. [4]
questions.answer: SELECT Name [1] FROM Student [1] ORDER BY Name (ascending) [2]; explicitly writing ASC is optional because SQL defaults to ascending order.
